metadata.equation: p- = p + v*dt + 0.5*(R*a + g)*dt^2, q- = q x exp(w*dt), reset G = I - 0.5*[dtheta]x
operations: Error-state Kalman filter, 200 IMU steps + 20 position fixes + 10 heading aids, error state 15 / measurement 3 and 1
metadata.reference: in-house numpy transcription of Sola's error-state equations
metadata.sampling: IMU readings are a constant-turn, slow-sway truth plus noise at the densities the filter is given; position fixes and heading aids are the truth plus their own noise
